name: Tyril I Lister
original_name: ティレル・I・リスター
source:
[i]“If you want to scream, I'll take you back to a special room. We have whips, guillotines, and even cucking stools... Pick your poison.”[/i]

[i]Sage of Integrity, Envoy of Misery[/i]

A preeminent inquisitor who condemns witches and their crimes. His polished looks and exceptional powers of deduction would earn him many fans were it not for the bitter scoldings he's so wont to give out. The snap of his whip only makes him that much more imposing, so many people find him hard to approach. As a result, Crius and Zenn are his only friends.

He has an unbending will and an incorruptible sense of justice, but an invisible collar still digs into his neck.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=tyril]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
